|game_text=If your [Hoth] objective on table, choose: take [Premium] Veers or a [Premium] AT-AT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if your AT-AT occupies a related battleground site. OR Retrieve an AT-AT Cannon.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Walker Garrison (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Walker Garrison (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 October 2023<ref name="ht-88182de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual22-Dark/large/walkergarrison.gif</code> as published 2 October 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/walkergarrison.gif holotable commit 88182de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If your [Hoth] objective on table, choose: take [Premium] Veers or a [Premium] AT-AT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if your AT-AT occupies a related battleground site. OR Retrieve an AT-AT Cannon.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Walker Garrison (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114020627/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 2, file created 6 October 2023: “If your [Hoth] objective on table, choose: take [Premium] Veers or a [Premium] AT-AT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if your AT-AT occupies a related battleground site. OR Retrieve an AT-AT Cannon.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Walker Garrison (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Walker Garrison”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Walker Garrison (V)]] (published 2 October 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Walker Garrison]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
